title: What NOT To Do If You’re Late for a Flight
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On November 11, 2022, a Monroe County Sheriff’s deputy observed a speeding motorcycle pass by him in Sugarloaf Key, FL. When the deputy attempted to conduct a traffic stop, it appeared the motorcycle wasn’t stopping. After several miles, the motorcyclist finally pulled over. He told deputies he was running late for his flight and never saw any patrol vehicles trying to stop him.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
